BnP was created for the [[Time_2_Hammer|Time2Hammer]] 2on2 league in 2019, where they played in the [[Time_2_Hammer#Advanced|Advanced]] division. The name comes from the general frenchness and [[Viag]] living in Montréal, Canada, where [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poutine Poutine] is a popular dish.
